stemBlocks: The graph shows changes in population size (number of individuals) of a species of tortoise over the last century. These tortoises are only found on one small island in the Galapagos.
Which of the following could account for the change in population shown after time Z on the graph?

1 reduced rainfall
2 reduced availability of resources
3 failure to adapt to competition from an introduced species

assets.alt: Graph showing population size (number of individuals) of a species of tortoise over time (years). The population is stable until time Z, after which it declines sharply.
